clips.send: Machine learning means learning from examples. The AI gets features, like size and colour. You give it labelled examples. For a new fruit it finds the k nearest examples and they vote. We check it on test fruit it has never seen. If a group is missing from the training data, the AI fails on that group. That is bias.

We check it on test fruit it has never seen. If a group is missing from the training data, the AI fails on that group. That is bias.

clips.send: 机器学习就是从例子中学习。AI 得到的是特征，比如大小和颜色。你给它带标签的例子。来了一个新水果，它就找离得最近的 k 个例子，让它们投票。我们用它从没见过的测试水果来检验它。如果训练数据里缺了某一类，AI 就会在这一类上出错，这就是偏差。
